title: Nice product, packaging... just not to my taste
text:
While I support the idea of this very much, it's just not to my taste..... i have tried a couple tea subsctiption boxes, and this, unfortunately, is my least favorite.

While it's a nice product, with lovely, efficient packaging (each shipment in a compact paper box with 3 resealable pouches, the problem is none of the teas have been enjoyable for me.

This isn't the company's fault, everyone has different taste, but i find the teas bland, a little weak overall, and i do know how to brew tea properly....

Lesson learned. It might be just right for you, for me it wasn't.
label: negative
